notes.title: Finance reading before Monday
notes.body: Correcting what I wrote yesterday: that was Financial Accounting only. Rodolfo has posted the Finance Session 1 materials and asks you to read the assigned chapters and review the slides before Monday's class, on present value analysis. - It is the one thing this weekend actually owes.
